title: Writing Emails 1
description: Short, real-life emails: invitations, thank-you notes, questions and cancellations. Aim for 60–80 words.

thumbnail.alt: An envelope with an @ symbol and a paper airplane

cards.prompt: Your friend invited you to a party on Saturday, but you can't go. Write a short email: thank them, explain why you can't go and suggest another plan.
followUps: Did you start with a greeting and finish with a closing?
Is your email between 60 and 80 words?

cards.prompt: You saw an ad for a used bike. Write an email to the seller: ask two questions about the bike and suggest a time to see it.
followUps: Did you start with a greeting and finish with a closing?
Is your email between 60 and 80 words?

cards.prompt: A colleague helped you with a difficult project. Write a short thank-you email and offer to help them in the future.
followUps: Did you start with a greeting and finish with a closing?
Is your email between 60 and 80 words?

cards.prompt: You need to cancel a dentist appointment. Write a polite email: apologize, explain briefly and ask for a new date.
followUps: Did you start with a greeting and finish with a closing?
Is your email between 60 and 80 words?

cards.prompt: Your teacher asked for ideas for the end-of-year trip. Write an email with one idea and two reasons why it's a good choice.
followUps: Did you start with a greeting and finish with a closing?
Is your email between 60 and 80 words?
